app_tagline: Spaced repetition vocabulary mastery without the complexity

auth.login_subtitle: Sign in to sync your reviews, level, and progress
auth.signup_subtitle: Create an account to persist your words and review schedules in the cloud
auth.success_signup: Account created successfully! Check your email if verification is required, or sign in.
auth.error_generic: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials and try again.
auth.supabase_not_configured: Please configure your Supabase URL and Anon Key in .env.local to enable cloud auth.

home.hero_title: Save thousands of words to memory, forever
home.hero_desc: Smart, effortless spaced repetition built on CEFR standards and SM-2 algorithm. No tedious setup, no manual card creation.
home.feature_1_desc: Pick your CEFR level and start reviewing high-yield curated words in seconds.
home.feature_2_desc: Spaced repetition predicts memory decay and brings back words right when you need to reinforce them.
home.feature_3_desc: Crystal clear Arabic definitions & context, or single-click Oxford-style English immersion.

onboarding.title: What is your current English level?
onboarding.subtitle: We will provide words from this level plus reinforce previously learned levels.

review.title: Daily Review Session
review.rate_prompt: How well did you recall this word?
review.completed_desc: No words are due for review right now. Come back later or switch your level to review more.
review.daily_limit_desc: Your limit resets every midnight. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited reviews.

dashboard.title: Progress & Statistics
dashboard.empty_reviewed: You haven't reviewed any words yet. Start a review session to see them here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.connect_account: Connect / Sign in to sync with cloud
settings.level_desc: Choose the level matching your current language proficiency
settings.reset_desc: Clear review history and restart from scratch (for testing)
settings.reset_desc_detail: This will permanently delete your entire review history and reset all your statistics, starting fresh as if you were a new user.
settings.reset_confirm: Are you sure you want to reset all progress data?
